decision: Keep active fixed no-memory pool at 8 (78/96 already committed); run 12 independent frozen-memory probes concurrently after BOTH first passes finish. Online memory remains sequential.
limitations: Six host-wide CPU snapshots over about 31 seconds; no per-core peak, WSL guest quota, disk latency or long-duration saturation claim. WSL working set is host accounting. CPU values include other applications.
user_authorization: User permits increasing concurrency when resource headroom exists.
